briefdescription.para: Generic isoparametric Lagrange element.

detaileddescription.para:
nDim
The dimension of the element (e.g., 2 for Quad4, 3 for Hex8).
nNodes
The number of nodes in the element (e.g., 4 for Quad4, 8 for Hex8).
This class provides common functionality for isoparametric elements, including mapping from natural to physical coordinates, Jacobian computation, and integration-based properties like centroid and volume.

Specific shape functions and derivatives must be specialized for concrete topologies. Specializations exist for Quad4 (2, 4) and Hex8 (3, 8). The class owns a copy of the node coordinates (unlike the MPM cell geometries, which map an external array); it is used as the geometry of particle domains (see MarmotParticleDomain.h).
